description: Fixed-date General Roman Calendar baseline from the Liturgy Office PDF, amended for identified Holy See changes through 11 October 2026. Baseline transcription has not been independently reviewed line by line; this is not a resolved ordo.

source.publisher: Catholic Bishops’ Conference of England and Wales — Liturgy Office
source.title: General Roman Calendar
source.rank_note: The source footnote states that an entry with no indicated rank is an Optional Memorial. All Souls’ Day is retained as a special commemoration rather than applying that default.

scope_notes: Movable observances printed below month tables are excluded and should be calculated with liturgical rules.
Fixed nominal dates do not account for precedence, transfers, omitted celebrations, optional memorial selection, or national/local calendars.
No liturgical colours have been assigned: the source PDF lists ranks but not colours.
Fixed-date additions and changes are recorded with per-entry amendment provenance. The original source PDF remains the provenance for unchanged entries.

The Memorial of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of the Church (2018) occurs on the Monday after Pentecost and is intentionally not part of this fixed-date dataset; implement it in movable-observance rules.
The dates and ranks given here are nominal General Roman Calendar facts and do not resolve liturgical precedence or England and Wales national differences.
